newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EU fund cuts would hit Portuguese jobs - minister.
newsitem.headline: EU fund cuts would hit Portuguese jobs - minister.

text.p: A possible reduction in European Union (EU) development funds from 1999 would cut jobs in Portugal, Employment Minister Maria Joao Rodrigues said.

Asked in an interview to outline the impact of any cut of EU cohesion, structural and regional funds, she said: "If the EU funds were reduced after 1999 this would bring without doubt bad consequences for employment prospects in Portugal."

EU funds received since Portugal's entry to the European Community in 1986 have been spent on building infrastructure, such as telecommunications and roads, high-technology investments and improving education, she said on Friday night.
Rodrigues estimated that EU development funds had directly created tens of thousands of jobs per year in Portugal over the past decade.
She said that 350,000 jobs were maintained in Portugal per year by public investments including EU funds.
